candidates.name: OpenUp
candidates.one_liner: An Amsterdam-based workplace mental well-being platform giving employees, managers, and HR teams access to preventive support, coaching, and insights.
why_ankit_fits: OpenUp sits at the intersection of workplace wellbeing, behavior change, people analytics, and scalable digital support.
Ankit can connect employee experience, product strategy, and responsible AI workflows without reducing mental wellbeing to a narrow HR benefit.
The platform's manager, employee, and HR surfaces fit his systems-thinking strength across multiple stakeholder journeys.
problems_to_solve: Turn anonymized wellbeing signals into practical interventions that improve resilience, retention, and engagement.
Design next-generation manager and employee journeys that make preventive support normal before burnout escalates.
Explore safe AI-assisted personalization and self-guided learning while preserving trust, privacy, and human care.

candidates.name: Amaha
candidates.one_liner: An India-focused mental healthcare ecosystem offering therapy, psychiatry, self-care, community support, and employee well-being programmes.
why_ankit_fits: Amaha combines clinical care, digital product, community support, and organizational wellbeing in a large underserved mental health market.
Ankit can bring systems thinking to the full care ecosystem across individuals, families, institutions, and workplaces.
The employee well-being programme creates room for product strategy, learning design, responsible AI workflows, and data-informed interventions.
problems_to_solve: Design integrated workplace wellbeing journeys that move from diagnosis and awareness to sustained behavior change.
Translate anonymized organizational insights into humane, actionable programmes for leaders and employees.
Explore scalable self-care and community experiences that improve access without weakening clinical trust or safety.
candidates.suggested_role: Strategic Advisor, Mental Health Ecosystem & Workplace Wellbeing

candidates.name: Hintsa Performance
candidates.one_liner: A Helsinki-headquartered human performance and wellbeing company helping leaders, athletes, teams, and organizations achieve sustainable success.
why_ankit_fits: Hintsa maps directly to human potential through the connection between purpose, wellbeing, learning, and sustainable performance.
Ankit can help translate a high-touch coaching method into scalable products, learning systems, and AI-enabled workflows without losing depth.
The company serves founders, leaders, and organizations under pressure, which fits Ankit's explorer-architect-builder mode.
problems_to_solve: Create productized pathways that make elite sustainable-performance methods useful to broader teams and organizations.
Connect coaching, diagnostics, learning, and digital tools into coherent journeys for leaders and critical talent.
Explore responsible AI support for reflection, habit formation, and coach leverage while preserving human judgment.
candidates.suggested_role: Strategic Advisor, Human Potential & Sustainable Performance
